description: This file declares the RDKWindowManager class, which implements plugin and JSON RPC interfaces for managing window-related functionalities within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It includes nested Notification class for handling remote connection events and user inactivity notifications.

classes.name: RDKWindowManager
classes.description: Main class implementing plugin and JSON RPC interfaces for window management, with lifecycle methods, internal state, and a nested Notification class for handling remote connection events.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Nested class within RDKWindowManager that handles remote connection notifications and user inactivity events.
